description: Source file for a Zephyr-based embedded application managing display, buttons, LEDs, and sensor interactions on a reel board with mesh networking features.

methods.name: print_line
methods.description: Prints a line of text on the display with specified font size, row, and alignment.

methods.name: get_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of text to fit within a font line, considering line breaks and spaces.

methods.name: board_blink_leds
methods.description: Triggers a quick LED blinking sequence.

methods.name: board_show_text
methods.description: Displays text on the screen, optionally centered, for a specified duration.

methods.name: add_hello
methods.description: Adds or updates a 'hello' message for a node address.

methods.name: add_heartbeat
methods.description: Adds or updates heartbeat info for a node address.

methods.name: show_statistics
methods.description: Displays network statistics and top message senders.

methods.name: show_sensors_data
methods.description: Displays sensor readings such as temperature, humidity, acceleration, and light.

methods.name: show_main
methods.description: Displays the main device name and status.

methods.name: epd_update
methods.description: Updates the display based on current screen ID.

methods.name: long_press
methods.description: Handles long press to cycle through screens.

methods.name: button_is_pressed
methods.description: Checks if the button is currently pressed.

methods.name: button_interrupt
methods.description: Interrupt handler for button press/release events.

methods.name: configure_button
methods.description: Configures GPIO for button input and interrupt.

methods.name: set_led_state
methods.description: Sets the state of a specified LED.

methods.name: board_init
methods.description: Initializes display, buttons, LEDs, and storage; resets device if button pressed.
